first_step_test: A tall rounded black housing in its final position gives the learner a clear container for all three signal circles.

source.notes: Six-panel handmade felt-tip contact sheet; inspect before cropping.

final_elements.description: One tall rounded rectangular traffic-light shell with broad black outline.

final_elements.name: top red lamp
final_elements.description: Top circular signal centered inside housing.

frames.instruction: With a black felt tip, draw one tall rounded rectangle with softly uneven corners. Leave the inside open for three stacked lights.
Inside the housing, draw three separate circles from top to bottom. Keep them similar in size and evenly spaced, with the lowest circle clear of the bottom edge.
Above each circle, add one short curved visor that follows the circle edge. Count exactly three visors, one per lamp.
From the center of the housing bottom, draw a short narrow pole. Attach a small flat base at the pole’s lower end.

frames.visible_job: Add two lower housing screw dots and three short ground marks.
frames.instruction: Put one tiny screw dot at each lower corner of the housing, then draw three separate short ground strokes beneath the base.

final_step.visible_job: Fill the established circles red, amber and green and the housing charcoal without adding structure.
final_step.instruction: Let the black outline dry. Fill the top circle red, middle amber and bottom green with streaky marker strokes, leaving tiny white paper glints. Shade the existing box charcoal and the pole deep teal.

No temporary guides were used or removed; no unexplained structural erasure or movement is visible.
